name: Pyromancer: Al Dente adds 15% Fire damage taken to Gaze of Ysera targets (#1777)
contract: #1777: Al Dente 300921 is a passive ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 23 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, value 14+1 = +15, class mask B 0x40000000, which selects Gaze of Ysera 806148 and its Sleep rank 503229. Their effect 3 is aura 87 MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PCT (Fire) with base 0, and flat effect modifiers are applied through SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue -> ApplyEffectModifiers (SpellInfo.cpp:520) even on a zero base. Asserts the effect-3 value of Gaze of Ysera is 0 before and 15 after learning the passive.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without Al Dente the effect 3 modifier is nil
Al Dente adds 15 to Gaze of Ysera effect 3
